title: An XP Algorithm for Maximum-Weight Independent Set in Embedded Graphs, in Lean 4
abstract: A Lean 4 and Mathlib formalization of Theorem 1 of "Maximum-weight independent set in embedded graphs parameterized by Euler genus and number of odd faces" (forthcoming), with a provably correct implementation of the algorithm as one fixed program for an explicit sixteen-register pointer machine. Lean proves that for every graph drawn in a closed surface of Euler genus gamma whose complement has k regions of odd total boundary length, and all rational vertex weights, the program outputs a maximum-weight independent set within f(gamma + k) * N^(D(gamma, k) + C) * (L + 1)^b bit operations, with D(gamma, k) = max {0, gamma + k - 2, gamma - 1}, improved to max {0, gamma + k - 2} on orientable surfaces; f is an explicit computable function and C, b are absolute constants. Surfaces are represented by finite combinatorial flag maps; disconnected and noncellular drawings, loops, multiple edges, isolated vertices and negative weights are covered. The cost is a logarithmic bit-cost measure including an explicit stack simulation of recursive calls. The proofs use exactly propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.
